sample_rule: first accepted look in each age-sex cohort; all ten frames
method: Viewed all 40 enlarged source/mask/source-hair-proxy/region panels, with four cohort overview sheets for adults and direct source-pixel review where needed. Read classifier construction only after the independent source-only region review was frozen. Counts and head-bound containment were recomputed from stored mask PNGs.

hair_denominator_assessment.provided_reference: source Lab L <= 48 and R-G < 55, source alpha >=128, within head support and shared allowed_hair geometry; protected dark ink remains in its denominator
hair_denominator_assessment.positive: This is separate from the Lloyd hair-label/classifier silhouette and includes protected ink, so it is not simply selected-mask/self coverage.
hair_denominator_assessment.failure: It is still a color/geometric proxy, with visible axe, arm, collar and blanket inclusion in multiple poses and possible clipped bun/side-hair in carries. Therefore its >=50% ratio does not establish coverage of the true semantic hair silhouette.
hair_denominator_assessment.replacement_ground_truth: NOT_CREATED - independent review did not paint or modify source/mask assets.

excluded_cluster_assessment.reported_zero_is_not_semantic_zero: Masks select particular classifier labels while excluded is the complementary label family. A zero intersection is a classifier consistency check; it does not independently prove absence of clothing/props, as the visual failures demonstrate.

limits: PASS is a source/mask visual cleanliness judgment at the recorded hashes; it does not pass strict coverage, identity, portrait quality, or owner acceptance.
UNCERTAIN regions are not counted as clean.
Automated non-idle face/arm boxes were not independently accepted as anatomy; literal counts are diagnostic outside S/idle.
This is the initial fixed40 snapshot. Later repairs must retain these failures and be reported as a separate reviewed revision.
